story.vex: A missing card, unrevoked. I'll walk in wearing someone else's access. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: the missing card is revoked the moment it's reported, and the vault was never just one layer deep. Astro: "A lost credential is an emergency now, not at end of shift."

ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
A cadet's engineering-bay access card is missing. Revoke it immediately.

1. cat incident-note.txt
2. sudo usermod -L badge-eng-07
files./home/cadet/citadel/incident-note.txt:
INCIDENT NOTE
---------------
Cadet reports their access card (badge-eng-07) missing since this morning. The card opens the engineering bay. The engineering vault beyond it requires biometric access, not just a card.

steps.title: Rivet's Workbench: read the incident
steps.body: Rivet: "Read it, then act — don't wait." `cat incident-note.txt`.

steps.title: Revoke the missing card now
steps.body: Rivet: "Now, not at end of shift." `sudo usermod -L badge-eng-07`.
